hero_subhead: A private, heritage room in Uptown Waterloo to gather the people who loved them. Our team handles the space quietly and completely, so your family can be present with each other.
band_intro: Some gatherings need quiet more than they need a program. Den 1880 gives your family a private, heritage room for a reception or celebration of life — exclusive use of the space, catering and bar handled by our team, and staff who stay out of the way until you need them.
incl_subhead: One point of contact, before and on the day, so your family isn't managing a venue.
cta_headline: Let Us Take Care Of The Room
cta_subhead: Call or write whenever suits you. Our events team will talk it through and hold the details, so your family can hold each other.
